title: The Science of Habit Formation: Why Your Brain Repeats Certain Behaviors
description: Learn how the brain builds habits and why some behaviors become automatic while others fade away. This guide explores habit formation, behavior change, neuroscience, and practical self-improvement strategies to help you create lasting routines. Discover the deeper reason habits stick, including the three-part habit loop that explains how cues, actions, and rewards shape behavior over time. See the full framework here.
alt_text: Infographic about The Science of Habit Formation showing how the brain creates lasting behaviors through patterns, cues, routines, and rewards with a focus on psychology and personal growth.
hidden_hook: The article reveals the three-part habit loop: cue, routine, and reward.
